sents.t: Nina Brooks (11:30 A.M.): I'm ordering lunch for the team meeting. Pizza or sandwiches?
Omar Haddad (11:32 A.M.): Sandwiches. Pizza makes the presentation slides greasy.
Nina Brooks (11:33 A.M.): Fair point. How many people are coming?
Omar Haddad (11:35 A.M.): Twelve, but Mr. Lee just told me he'll join us late.
Nina Brooks (11:36 A.M.): Then I'll order thirteen, just in case. He always eats two.
